decisions.text: Hook install: tracked .githooks/ shims plus a local core.hooksPath. When node or the package is missing, the shim prints one line and exits 0, never blocking the commit, the SessionStart hook's contract. A repo with a foreign hooksPath (husky, lefthook) is reported by doctor with the reason; a backlog enhancement records that init could append the shim call into those hooks instead of stopping.

Changelog: generated only, no stored Unreleased section. A repo with no release tag yet must pass --check (an empty generated changelog is byte-stable), with a test, since every user's repo starts there. This repo's hand-written Unreleased lines are dropped.

Doc-sync dogfood: one rule, the bundle CLI and workflow (bundle.mjs, src/lib/bundle/*, bundle-phase.js, tests excluded by pathspec) require docs/playbook.md or the bundle skill staged. The rules block's doc-sync line says that a COOKWRIGHT_SKIP=doc-sync commit carries the reason in its message, since the escape itself leaves no trace.

A foreign hooks setup (core.hooksPath elsewhere or from a non-local origin, or user hooks in the hooks dir) is WARN on hooks.path with the reason, not FAIL: a chosen state, not drift; a permanent FAIL the user cannot clear trains them to ignore doctor. FAIL stays for unset (run init) and for our shim present but broken. The two file checks SKIP.

pre-push runs the single gate.checks list in this stage and prints the elapsed time on the pre-push gate line; a backlog enhancement opens for a hooks.push list that overrides gate.checks on push, since the bundle gate wants thorough and the push hook wants cheap enough never to be bypassed.
